annotationProvenance.initialExtraction: PaLM extraction from public reviewer-author discussions
annotationProvenance.humanRevision: Expert relevance filtering, question/answer decontextualization, source-document version annotation and reference editing
annotationProvenance.agreementScope: 200 shared relevance-filtering examples; 85 percent agreement before discussion; remaining examples single-annotator

limitations: Preserve published expert-revised questions and answers; initial PaLM extraction is declared.
Public JSON has no complete evidence spans, PDF hashes, table/figure/equation targets or per-row scientific task categories.
OpenReview paper and discussion IDs are source identities, not annotator identities.
Initial/Revised labels must not be replaced by whichever PDF is currently available.
Publication-wide modality percentages cannot be assigned to individual rows.
No upstream model responses or executable pickle files are acquired.
